# NYT Cooking

> > The New York Times's comprehensive recipe collection and cooking platform featuring thousands of tested recipes from acclaimed food writers like Melissa Clark, Eric Kim, and Ali Slagle.

NYT Cooking offers curated recipe collections, cooking guides, and culinary expertise from The New York Times food team. The site features quick weeknight dinners, international cuisines, classic techniques, and seasonal cooking inspiration with contributions from renowned chefs and cookbook authors including Marcella Hazan, Lidia Bastianich, and Martha Rose Shulman.

## Key Topics

- Recipe Collections
- Quick Weeknight Dinners
- 20-Minute Meals
- Italian Cooking & Sauces
- Melissa Clark
- Eric Kim
- Ali Slagle
- Pasta Sauces (Marinara, Pesto, Bolognese)
- Fast Cooking Techniques
- Grilling & Vegetarian
- Classic Recipes
- Korean Cuisine
- Martha Rose Shulman
- Julia Moskin
- Marcella Hazan

## Quick & Easy Weeknight Dinners

- [Crazy Fast Dinners Ready in 20 Minutes or Less](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/2825551-crazy-fast-dinners-ready-in-20-minutes-or-less?action=click&module=Collection+Page+Collection+Card&region=Collection+Page+Recirculation&pgType=collection&rank=2): Curated collection of 20-minute weeknight dinner recipes by NYT Cooking

## Classic Italian Cooking

- [Classic Italian Sauces You Should Know By Heart](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/1734674-classic-italian-sauces-you-should-know-by-heart?action=click&module=Collection+Page+Collection+Card&region=Collection+Page+Recirculation&pgType=collection&rank=3): Essential Italian pasta sauce recipes including marinara, pesto, bolognese

## International & Regional Cuisines

- [Eric Kim's 10 Essential Korean Recipes](https://cooking.nytimes.com/68861692-nyt-cooking/40794634-eric-kims-10-essential-korean-recipes?action=click&module=See+More+Recipes&region=Eric+Kim’s+10+Essential+Korean+Recipes&pgType=supercollection&rank=10): Eric Kim's essential Korean recipes: tteokbokki, kimchi fried rice, more

## Vegetarian & Grilling

- [Layered Vegetable Torte Recipe](https://cooking.nytimes.com/recipes/1013213-layered-vegetable-torte?action=click&module=Collection+Band+Recipe+Card&region=Vegetarian+Grilling+Essentials&pgType=supercollection&rank=2): Grilled or roasted vegetable torte recipe with layered technique
